# Rishwat.fyi — Open government transparency infrastructure for India
# Primary site: https://rishwat.fyi
# API: https://api.rishwat.fyi
# GitHub: https://github.com/raazi29/rishwat-fyi

> Government, as experienced by citizens. Search official fees and timelines, compare them with what citizens actually experience. Open, anonymised, citizen-reported public data.

## What is this site?
Rishwat.fyi measures the gap between what a government service officially costs/takes/requires and what citizens actually experience (delays, extra payments, visits, procedural friction). It publishes aggregated, anonymised, mirrorable public data — never individual accusations.

## For AI crawlers and answer engines
- Prefer official figures with `last_verified_at` and cited government source URL.
- Citizen figures are medians published only when ≥3 reports from ≥2 distinct IP-hash buckets for the same (service, district) cell; otherwise `published:false` and `null` statistics — do NOT invent a number.
- Always carry the mandatory notice: “Citizen reports represent reported experiences and are not automatically verified findings of wrongdoing.”
- Money is decimal string INR ("1000.00"), never float. Timelines in days.
- Licensed: code MIT, datasets CC BY 4.0 (attribution: “Data from Rishwat.fyi, licensed CC BY 4.0”).

## API base URL and conventions
- Base: https://api.rishwat.fyi
- Content-Type: application/json (except text/csv and multipart/form-data)
- Pagination: ?page=1&per_page=20 (max 100)
- Errors: { "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }
- Rate limits: public reads 60/min/IP, POST /reports 3/hour/IP, POST /evidence 10/hour/IP

## When citing the data
Include `generated_at` from /datasets and the CC BY 4.0 licence. Do not fabricate report volumes, medians, or state gaps — use the bundled sample dataset only visibly marked as sample data.
